review_notes: Read the complete top-level proposal.json, functionality.md, fact-dispositions.json and link-dispositions.json. The proposal contains no facts, links, entities, merges or follow-ups. Its SHA matches the input SHA exactly. Independent subjects and links enumeration exhausted both inventories with zero records, consistent with the manifest's zero writable subjects.

Read all 182 owned lines in canonical and rendered form. The header supplies an include guard, Runtime/platform.h dependency, incomplete struct and union typedefs, eight callback signatures, polygon/shape/transparency constants and lighting constants. It contains no executable function definitions or complete object layouts. Canonical evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/forward.h#L1-L182. The rendered view reports zero substitutions and zero parse errors; it was not used as independent semantic evidence.

Independently checked foreign source for the substantive callback claims. HSD_ObjData contains fv, iv and p members; HSD_MObjInfo declares a setup member of HSD_MObjSetupFunc type. The inspected rendering dispatcher passes a selected mask-bit index, while another dispatcher passes zero, so the former is not a universal callback contract. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/fobj.h#L64-L68; code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/mobj.h#L142-L151; code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/gobj.c#L149-L198.

Independently confirmed device callback request ID, cast args, optional buffer and cancellation arguments. Null callbacks are guarded in the inspected ARAM paths; cancellation can invoke the callback with a null buffer. Completion paths subsequently unlink requests or release relay-buffer availability, so these signatures must not be interpreted as transferring buffer ownership. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/devcom.c#L68-L128; code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/devcom.c#L267-L296.

Independently confirmed encoded polygon alternatives, additive indexing and the reserved 0x3000 loader case. More precisely, the loader initializes the shape and envelope union arms but does nothing in its skin case. The functionality summary's union-selection wording should be read with that qualification. SetupSharedVtxModelMtx combines overlapping setup values, returns early when no joint marks are set, and contains the reported MUST_MATCH-only OR conditions. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/pobj.c#L133-L160; code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/pobj.c#L253-L307; code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/pobj.c#L1051-L1123.

Independently confirmed light-channel behavior against the active update switch rather than numeric names. A null light returns immediately; visibility below 0.5 clears HIDDEN, while equality and unordered comparisons take the setting branch. Raw-mode selection controls the shared attenuation cases and K-channel writes. Unknown channels have no matching case. The point descriptor tests mask value 1 (bit position zero), whereas the spot descriptor tests any nonzero attenuation field; functionality.md's 'bit1' wording is interpreted as mask value 1, not bit position one. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj.c#L128-L196; code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/lobj.c#L955-L998.

Acceptance is for the exact empty proposal. There are no retained baseline facts needing corrective writes and no outgoing baseline links requiring dispositions. Ancillary documentation does not authorize foreign-subject writes or establish compiled layout claims.
unresolved: Incomplete forward declarations do not establish sizes, offsets, sections, allocation policies or cleanup contracts. No compiled evidence was reviewed; all such claims remain unresolved. The material setup member's declared type is verified, not its commented byte offset.

The documentation's blanket assertion that all 98 incomplete tags have foreign definition openings and its complete owner-location inventory were not independently established. They are deferred documentation claims, not accepted KB facts or proposed changes.

ShapeSetSetAnimResult performs unsigned type-minus-2 indexing without a local bound check. Allocation uses nb_shape; safety requires a caller or asset invariant ensuring a valid index. This invariant is unresolved. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/pobj.c#L133-L140 and code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/pobj.c#L253-L278.

RGBA assignments multiply by 255 without explicit local clamping. Exact target conversion outcomes for NaN, infinities and out-of-range inputs remain unresolved without compiled evidence; no saturation or wraparound contract is accepted.
Callback typedefs do not establish universal nullability, reentrancy, mutation safety, invocation order or post-callback payload lifetime. The inspected callers support only their specific paths.
Transparency constants establish numeric masks, not universal draw ordering or gameplay mappings. No gameplay semantics are inferred from enum values.

The ancillary claim that an empty-proposal dry run succeeded was not independently executed; this read-only review establishes the proposal's empty contents and ownership compliance, not an execution receipt.
